title: GAX-P08 - Final-test freeze and claim-evidence contract
outcome: Make P08 final-test access an explicit digest-bound transition and make affirmative paper claims machine-readable, evidence-bound, and unable to silently discard null, rejected, blocked, or exploratory outcomes.
rationale: P08 is the first paper-eligible evaluation phase. Without an enforceable pre-test freeze, GAX could accidentally tune thresholds, representations, baseline identities, metrics, or failure rules after observing test outcomes. Without a claim ledger, negative or blocked results could disappear from the public story. SG-000011 therefore builds the smallest pre-test-safe governance surface before any final-test access.
scope_in: Benchmark split, leakage-audit, and license-audit hash binding
Hardware, failure, evidence, intervention, and FHIR protocol revision freeze
Digest-bound authorization into a separate artifact
Standalone governance CLI and synthetic regression fixtures
scope_out: No final-test labels or results are opened in SG-000011
No real benchmark score is produced
No model or baseline superiority claim
No ECAL mechanism keep decision from synthetic fixtures
No clinical-safety, deployment, regulatory, or FHIR-certification claim
No removal of blocked or negative outcomes from the claim ledger
acceptance: P08 freeze manifests are immutable strict Pydantic contracts with unknown fields rejected
Authorization requires a clean repository tree and frozen benchmark test manifests
Every benchmark freeze binds split-manifest, leakage-audit, and license-audit SHA-256 digests
Every qualified system binds a source or model revision and every blocked system records an explicit reason
The manifest contains at least one GAX system and one baseline/control system
Calibration freeze forbids test tuning and target coverages are unique, sorted, and in (0,1]
Statistical freeze requires at least 1000 bootstrap replicates plus primary metrics/comparisons and multiplicity policy
Authorized manifests carry a digest computed from the exact authorized payload with the digest field excluded
Tampering with an authorized manifest invalidates schema validation or authorization verification
Authorization is written to a separate artifact rather than overwriting the sealed source manifest
Supported claims require at least one evidence-packet ID
Null, rejected, and blocked claims require explicit reasons
Exploratory claims cannot be primary candidates
Claim-ledger export exposes only supported claims as affirmative publishable claims while preserving other states in the ledger

The 2026-09-26 literature refresh explicitly raises the novelty bar beyond generic Jev-like typed decisions and records peer-reviewed medical abstention, FHIR-agent, EHR-agent, and evidence-verification anchors
Synthetic P08 fixtures contain no patient data, clinical threshold, or paper performance result
Exact-head CI passes Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
Implementation merges with expected-head guard and post-main CI succeeds before SG-000011 can close

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000011 and P08 freeze/claim files to canonical P07. No final-test data, clinical model release, or production behavior is changed by this grain.

minimality.rationale: The minimal safe P08 step is to make the test-opening and claim-promotion rules executable before qualifying or running real models on final evaluation data.

requirements: Do not open final-test labels/results in this grain.
Do not turn synthetic governance fixtures into performance evidence.
Do not authorize a dirty-tree experiment.
Do not silently drop blocked baselines or negative claims.
Do not promote exploratory findings into primary claims.

unresolved_decisions: Actual P08 benchmark/data identities remain sealed until license and leakage audits complete.
Actual final GAX checkpoint set remains unresolved until development-only mechanism gates complete.
Actual external baseline checkpoint qualification remains pending zero-founder-cost execution where applicable.

Linux Python 3.12: Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, compileall PASS
Windows Python 3.11: Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, compileall PASS
Windows Python 3.12: Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, compileall PASS
Post-main CI SUCCESS on canonical merge
closeout.scientific_boundary: SG-000011 proves only the pre-test governance and evidence-contract layer. Final-test access remains sealed. It does not prove a paper metric, model advantage, clinical validity, ECAL benefit, abstention benefit, evidence grounding, FHIR superiority, or efficiency superiority.
